disambiguation: Not a simple command runner; it functions as a full mobile-first input and submission workflow for external automation.
extras: The plugin claims not to send instruction text, attachment content, filenames, or Vault paths to the wake service.
problem: Users need a unified, mobile-friendly way to capture complex instructions and associated files to trigger external automated processes.
summary: JDB Command is a mobile-first command center that allows users to input, record, and attach instructions to trigger external actions via a Windows backend.
